name: Nettle
note: Stinging nettle, Urtica dioica (docs/future/13 section 5, P2b). A tea herb: the walker gathers its young tops in spring and again in autumn (recipes/world/gather.json nettle.tops). The sting is a field note only, never any harm (Matt, October 24, 2026). Drawn with the thrift shader as campion is (draw: thrift; flora-thrift.wgsl): a close stand of tall, broad, dark leaves and no flower heads (its green catkins do not show at this size). habitat (docs/future/13 5.3): rich soil with no standing water, little salt, moderately damp. Nettles follow people's ash: it arrives only near the camp fire once the fire has burned on 3 nights (volunteer.cause, P2b B6, after the plant-rules cause filter). growth: the herb defaults of 5.4, drowning under 5 cm of water for 48 hours. It rests as a low brown crown in winter (dormant; crown as in meadowsweet.json). spread kind rhizome as in watermint.json, creeping in spring into early summer, up to maxCount on the island. volunteer.seasons: spring to autumn. starter: test links only. plantTool false: gather plants are not offered by the Plant tool.

phenology.note: each plant keeps its own calendar, offset from the species by up to jitterDays game days either way (hash of the plant id; src/world/growth/phenology.js)
